description: Marks one of this week's moves as done (or reopens it), edits its title or reason, or dismisses it with a reason. Only when the maker asks.

change.description: done: the maker did it (added to the journal). reopen: undo done. edit: new title and/or why. dismiss: remove it, with a reason.

note.description: dismiss: a few words from the maker.

project.description: Which project: its id or site (example.com) from uptake_projects. Optional when the maker has a single project.

reason.description: dismiss: not_relevant (not relevant), already_done (already done), wrong_numbers (wrong numbers), not_my_channel (not a channel i use), too_much_time (too much time), other (other).

title.description: edit: new title, an imperative of at most 80 characters.

name: uptake_update_move
title: Update a move
